kb_proposals: ERS §4.2–4.3 on T1/T2, second countable backgrounds: CausalScaffold.Ers464SecondCountable (T-abs-ers-4-64-second-countable). `…_secondCountable` = the original less discharged binders (hext, through-hypotheses, and hsplit/hacausal only where the original also has S Cauchy in the same W for the same causality, plus W causally arc-connected for hacausal). `…_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_secondCountable` = hacausal, hsplit traded for IsCauchySurfaceOn U₁ S and CausallyArcConnectedOn U₁ (DEC-162). Together with Causal.ErsSecondCountable, no ERS §4 theorem needs curves_extend, InextensibleThrough, SplitBy or IsAcausalOn except Thm 4.75's IsLocalDevelopment, maxDevelopmentIn_eq, ers_theorem_4_64_in and ers_prop_4_63 (OQ-41 reading).

Checking 'the original less some binders' mechanically: an `elab "#binders" n:ident` command that runs forallTelescope on the constant's type and logs each binder (binder info, user name, ppExpr type) and the body, run on both constants in a /tmp file that imports the module (or a copy of it), then a difflib.SequenceMatcher on the (binderinfo, name, type) lists. It prints exactly the removed and added binders and whether the conclusions agree; 27 pairs took one `lake env lean` run (T-abs-ers-4-64-second-countable).

`lake build <Module> --no-build` exits 3 and prints the jobs that are out of date without building anything: a dry run that shows whether upstream (Causal.*, mathlib) would be rebuilt before you start the real `lake build <Module>`.

Where an original takes InextensibleThrough U only to pass it to an open V ≤ U (InextensibleThrough.of_le, which needs T2 and ≤_U antisymmetric), its second countable form needs only T1: InextensibleThrough V holds directly (inextensibleThrough_of_t1_secondCountable C V).
